name: World Flags
description: Guess the country from its flag, by continent or the whole world. Rounds of 10 with streaks and a list of the ones to review.
prompt: A flags quiz: pick a continent or the whole world, see a big flag and choose the country among four options from the same region, with streaks, best scores per region and a list of the flags you missed.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Adivina el país por su bandera, por continente o de todo el mundo. Rondas de 10 con rachas y una lista de las que repasar.
